detail.statement: Flow-controlled autocatalytic reaction networks can exhibit history-dependent responses that function as chemical memory, distinct from simple state hysteresis.
detail.reason: New algebraic evidence [peer-a2fc78f9c0fb4e42f8cc3e12] reinforces the identification of irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks necessary for persistent, history-dependent chemical states, distinguishing them from simple hysteresis effects [peer-756d5cf5076d5b4a00b1070b].

children.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: Recent findings identify algebraic conditions for identifying irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks within stoichiometric matrices and demonstrate programmable, history-dependent chemical responses in flow-controlled reaction systems.
detail.reason: Incorporating new stoichiometric network analysis and experimental flow-reactor evidence to advance the project on autocatalytic chemical memory.
